column2: Using fresh data, the economist refuted the claim that prices always rise in spring.
column3: 經濟學家用新的數據，駁斥了「春天物價一定上漲」的說法。
column5: re 回 + fute 打：拿出證據，把對方的論證打回去

column2: At the hearing, the lawyer rebutted each charge with a witness and a document.
column3: 在聽證會上，律師用一位證人和一份文件，逐一反駁每項指控。
column5: re 回 + but：回你一句「But，我有反證」

column2: The mayor countered the critics by pointing to the falling crime rate.
column3: 市長指出犯罪率正在下降，藉此反駁批評者。
column5: counter 站在對面：對方出招，你就站對面回擊

column2: Students are encouraged to challenge ideas, even those printed in the textbook.
column3: 學生被鼓勵去質疑各種想法，連課本上印的也不例外。
column4: challenge an assumption (質疑一項假設)
column5: challenge 像比賽邀請：你說的我不信，來辯一辯

column2: Nobody disputes that the planet is warming; the argument is about the cause.
column3: 沒有人質疑地球正在變暖，爭論的只是原因。
column4: dispute a claim (對說法提出異議)
column5: dis 分開 + pute 想：想法分成兩邊，就吵起來了

column2: His story contradicts the security video, which shows him at the station at noon.
column3: 他的說法與監視器畫面互相矛盾，畫面顯示他中午人在車站。
column5: contra 相反 + dict 說：嘴上說的剛好相反

column2: There is a glaring contradiction between what the company says and what it does.
column3: 這家公司所說的與所做的之間，有明顯的矛盾。
column5: contradict 加 -ion：左嘴說 A，右嘴卻說 B

column2: An auditor spotted a discrepancy between the invoice total and the payment record.
column3: 稽核員發現發票總額與付款紀錄之間有出入。
column4: a discrepancy between (兩者之間的出入)
column5: 兩本帳對不起來，數字 dis 開了，差了一截

column2: The editor flagged an inconsistency: the hero's eyes are blue in chapter one and green in chapter two.
column3: 編輯標出一處不一致：主角的眼睛在第一章是藍色，第二章卻是綠色。
column4: an inconsistency in the story (故事中的不一致)
column5: in 不 + consistent 一致：前後對不上

column2: It is a paradox that the more choices we have, the less satisfied we often feel.
column3: 我們的選擇越多，往往越不滿足，這是個矛盾的現象。
column5: para 超出 + dox 想法：超出常理的想法，卻可能是真的
column8: 矛盾論點；看似矛盾的實況

column2: The irony is that the fire station burned down while the firefighters were out on a call.
column3: 諷刺的是，消防員出勤時，消防局自己卻失火了。
column4: the irony of fate (命運的諷刺)
column5: 諧音「愛弱你」：結果和預期相反，真是諷刺
column8: 諷刺；反諷；令人啼笑皆非之處

column2: It was ironic that the lifeguard had never learned to swim.
column3: 諷刺的是，這位救生員從來沒學過游泳。
column5: irony 變形容詞：事情反過來，令人哭笑不得
column8: 反諷的；具有諷刺意味的

column2: Her sarcasm was obvious when she said "Great job" after he dropped the whole tray.
column3: 他把整個托盤摔了之後，她說「幹得好」，挖苦的意味十分明顯。
column5: 讀音像「沙卡絲」：話裡帶沙，像砂紙一樣刮人

column2: The play is a satire that mocks politicians who care more about cameras than voters.
column3: 這齣戲是一部諷刺作品，嘲弄那些重視鏡頭多過選民的政客。
column5: 諧音「賽特爾」：用笑話賽一賽社會的毛病

column2: The camel's wide feet are an adaptation to walking on loose sand.
column3: 駱駝寬大的腳掌是適應在鬆軟沙地上行走的演化特徵。
column4: adaptation to the climate (對氣候的適應)
column5: adapt 加 -ation：為了生存而改變身體或習性
column8: 生物適應；演化機能適應

column2: Polar bears have adapted to life on sea ice over thousands of years.
column3: 北極熊經過數千年，已適應了海冰上的生活。
column5: ad 向 + apt 合適：朝合適的樣子慢慢改變

column2: The evolution of birds from small dinosaurs took millions of years.
column3: 鳥類從小型恐龍演化而來，歷經了數百萬年。
column5: e 向外 + volv 滾動：像卷軸慢慢展開，一步步發展

column2: Fear of snakes may have an evolutionary origin, helping early humans avoid danger.
column3: 對蛇的恐懼可能有演化上的起源，幫助早期人類避開危險。
column5: evolution 加 -ary：像寶可夢進化那樣，跟演化有關的
column7: ev - o - lu - tion - ar - y

column2: Coral reefs shelter an astonishing biodiversity, from tiny shrimp to giant sea turtles.
column3: 珊瑚礁庇護著驚人的生物多樣性，從小蝦到巨大的海龜都有。
column5: bio 生命 + diversity 多樣：生命有很多種
column7: bi - o - di - ver - si - ty
column8: 生物多樣性；物種豐富度

column2: A pond is a small ecosystem where plants, fish, insects, and bacteria depend on one another.
column3: 池塘是個小小的生態系統，植物、魚、昆蟲與細菌彼此依賴。
column4: a fragile ecosystem (脆弱的生態系統)
column5: eco 家 + system 系統：生物們共住的一個大家庭

column2: The wetland is the natural habitat of the endangered black-faced spoonbill.
column3: 這片濕地是瀕危黑面琵鷺的天然棲息地。
column5: 諧音「哈比塔」：哈！比塔還棒的家，就是動物的住所

column2: Each species fills a niche, such as feeding at night or eating only seeds.
column3: 每個物種都占有一個生態位，例如夜間覓食，或只吃種子。
column5: 諧音「你去」：這個位置你去，每種動物都有專屬位置
column8: 生態位；利基市場；適合位置

column2: The clownfish and the sea anemone live in symbiosis, each protecting the other.
column3: 小丑魚與海葵共生，彼此互相保護。
column5: sym 一起 + bio 生命：一起生活、互相幫忙

column2: Bees and flowering plants have a symbiotic relationship: one gets food, the other gets pollinated.
column3: 蜜蜂與開花植物是共生互利的關係：一方得到食物，另一方得到授粉。
column4: a symbiotic relationship (共生互利關係)
column5: symbiosis 的形容詞：兩邊都得到好處

column2: A tick is a parasite that feeds on the blood of dogs and deer.
column3: 壁蝨是靠吸食狗和鹿的血維生的寄生生物。
column4: a parasite on its host (宿主身上的寄生物)
column5: para 旁邊 + site 食物：坐在別人旁邊蹭飯的傢伙

column2: The parasitic vine slowly drained nutrients from the tree it climbed.
column3: 這株寄生的藤蔓慢慢吸走了所攀附那棵樹的養分。
column5: parasite 變形容詞：專門蹭別人飯吃的
column8: 寄生的；依賴他人生活的

column2: The owl is a night predator that hunts mice in the fields.
column3: 貓頭鷹是夜間的捕食者，在田野裡獵捕老鼠。
column5: predator 獵人、prey 獵物，都是 p 開頭的一對

column2: The predatory fish lurks in the weeds and strikes at passing minnows.
column3: 這條掠食性的魚潛伏在水草間，攻擊游過的小魚。
column5: predator 變形容詞：像獵手一樣盯著獵物的

column2: The hawk circled above, searching the meadow for prey.
column3: 老鷹在上空盤旋，在草地上尋找獵物。
column5: prey 跟 pray 禱告同音：獵物只能禱告別被發現

column2: Squirrels forage for acorns all autumn to store food for winter.
column3: 松鼠整個秋天都在四處覓食橡實，為冬天儲備糧食。
column5: for + age：為了度過漫長冬天而出門找吃的

column2: A cow is a herbivore, so its diet is made up entirely of grass and hay.
column3: 牛是草食性動物，所以牠的食物完全由青草與乾草組成。
column4: a herbivore's diet (草食動物的飲食)
column5: herb 草本 + vore 吃：吃草的動物

column2: The lion is a carnivore that depends on the meat of zebras and antelope.
column3: 獅子是肉食性動物，靠斑馬與羚羊的肉維生。
column4: a carnivore's teeth (肉食動物的牙齒)
column5: carn 肉（像 chili con carne 墨西哥肉醬）+ vore 吃

column2: Humans are omnivores, eating both vegetables and meat.
column3: 人類是雜食性動物，蔬菜和肉類都吃。
column5: omni 全部（omnibus 載所有人的公車）+ vore 吃：什麼都吃

column2: The island's rich flora includes orchids, ferns, and several rare trees.
column3: 這座島豐富的植物群包括蘭花、蕨類與幾種稀有樹木。
column4: local flora and fauna (當地動植物)
column5: Flora 是羅馬神話的花神，花草的總稱就是 flora

column2: Visitors to the park can see the native fauna, such as deer, foxes, and owls.
column3: 公園的遊客可以看到當地的動物群，像是鹿、狐狸與貓頭鷹。
column5: flora 花、fauna 動物，兩個常成對出現

column2: Exercise speeds up your metabolism, so your body burns energy faster.
column3: 運動會加快你的新陳代謝，讓身體更快燃燒能量。
column4: a slow metabolism (緩慢的新陳代謝)
column5: meta 改變：食物被改變，變成身體能用的能量

column2: Diabetes is a metabolic disorder in which the body cannot control blood sugar well.
column3: 糖尿病是一種代謝疾病，身體無法妥善控制血糖。
column5: metabolism 的形容詞：跟身體燃燒能量有關的

column2: Seeds can remain in dormancy for years until rain and warmth wake them.
column3: 種子可以休眠多年，直到雨水與暖意把它們喚醒。
column5: dorm 宿舍是睡覺的地方，dormancy 就是睡很久

column2: The volcano has been dormant for centuries, but scientists still watch it closely.
column3: 這座火山已沉寂了幾百年，但科學家仍密切監測它。
column5: dorm 睡覺 + ant：睡著了，暫時不動

column2: The community showed remarkable resilience, rebuilding its school within a month of the flood.
column3: 社區展現出驚人的韌性，在洪水後一個月內就重建了學校。
column5: re 回 + sil 跳：被壓扁又彈回原狀，像彈簧
column8: 生態復原力；環境適應彈性
